title: enforce_timestamping_eku_critical_and_sole has two ok_or arms with identical error strings; collapse via .as_deref().unwrap_or(&[])
close_reason:
Duplicate of PKIX-sqek.41, filed independently by the other pkix-chain review pass on the same day. Both carried real analysis (1935 and 2160 characters), so this is two reviewers finding the same defect rather than a bookkeeping error -- corroboration, not noise.

Fixed together; see PKIX-sqek.41 for the change and for the second instance of the pattern in the same function that neither bead had noticed.
